svg.title: P3A Dents and scratches - Ayas coupon template (1:1)
svg.text: P3A Dents and scratches
role: train | plate 100 x 100 x 3 mm | drill Ø4.1 for Ø4 fasteners | Ayas aircraft-representative coupon (commercial alloy)

g.title: D9 scratch.scriber: scriber 1 light pass; light
D11 scratch.scriber: scriber 5 firm passes; heavy
D13 scratch.abrasion: 220 grit 30 strokes along u

g.text: Print at 100 % (actual size, no 'fit to page').
Check: this bar must measure 50.0 mm.

svg.text: Datum corner A = top-left of face A: punch a small 'A' at the marked spot. Coordinates in mm from A: u
right, v down.
Make:
1. Punch the datum "A" (top-left of face A) if not done; photograph faces A and B bare.
2. Tape the P3A template on face A; centre-punch the 4 hole crosshairs; drill 2.5 mm pilots then 4.1 mm;
deburr both sides. Do not rivet yet.
3. Put the plate flat on a steel block. Punch dents through the template at the marked settings (same
session and settings as S2A) - near D1 low x1, D2 mid x2, D3 high x3; far D4 low x3, D5 mid x1, D6 high
4. Ball dents on the steel block (practise first on face B of P4) - steel ball on the mark, hammer blow -
D7 light (aim 5.5 mm across), D8 firm (aim 7.5 mm).
5. Set 4 blind rivets R1-R4 (heads on face A).
6. Scratches along a steel rule between the marked start and end points - D9 scriber 1 light pass, D10 3
passes, D11 5 firm passes; gouge D12 with the corner of a flat file, 3 passes.
7. Abrasion D13 - mask a 10 x 10 mm window with tape, 220 grit on a small flat block, 30 strokes along u;
remove the tape.
8. Blend X1 (rework mark, not a defect) - 220 grit over the steel ball, rotate to a 10 mm dish about 0.25
mm deep, finish with 400 grit.
9. Edge nicks D14 (left edge) and D15 (right edge) - 3-5 strokes of a triangular needle file across the
face-A edge corner.
10. Clean with isopropyl alcohol; photograph; measure.
Designed findings:
dent_minor D1, dent_minor D2, dent_minor D3, dent_negligible D4, dent_negligible D5, dent_negligible D6,
dent_negligible D7, dent_negligible D8
